notes:
Band High: verified by TWO INDEPENDENT official hospital sources that agree. (1) carehospitals.com - his own doctor page, URL name-slug 'mamindla-ravi-kumar', specialty-slug 'neurosurgeon', city 'hyderabad', branch segment 'malakpet', matching the input row's name + Neurosurgery/Epilepsy + CARE Hospitals Malakpet + Hyderabad on four criteria; he also appears on CARE's Malakpet neurosurgery panel, Malakpet neurosciences CoE panel and Hyderabad epilepsy-doctors panel (the epilepsy listing directly corroborates the input row's 'Neurosurgery, Epilepsy' specialty). (2) premierhospital.in - a different hospital group's own site, with its own doctor page for 'Dr Mamindla Ravi kumar', Neurosurgeon, Senior Consultant, Toli Chowki Hyderabad. These are genuinely independent organisations, which is what the banding rule requires for High. His own website and Facebook page are primary self-published and were NOT counted toward the band.

Name spelling: CARE's page title renders it 'Dr. Mamindha Ravi Kumar' while the URL slug and Premier's page both use 'Mamindla' - same person, CARE has a typo in the title tag. Ambiguity risk on 'Dr. Ravi Kumar' is real and was handled: a DIFFERENT Dr Ravi Kumar (neurosurgeon, 12 years, KIMS Sunshine Hospitals Begumpet) surfaced and was excluded; every URL recorded here carries either the 'Mamindla/Mamindha' surname or was confirmed against it. The personal website drravikumarneurosurgeon.com is attributed to him on the strength of the matching Facebook handle plus the site's 'King Koti' positioning matching his documented former post at Kamineni Hospital, King Koti - a human should spot-check that attribution.

CONTACT FIELDS - REJECTED VALUES. '+91-40-68106529' was returned in TWO separate search summaries, once presented as his CARE booking line and once, wrongly, as the booking line for PREMIER Hospital. It is the CARE Hospitals GROUP central switchboard and was rejected both times; note in particular that a summary attached it to a non-CARE hospital, which is a clear demonstration that the summariser is pattern-filling rather than reading a page. A JustDial listing ('Dr. Ravi Kumar Neuro Surgeon, Abids') was rejected as a call-tracking proxy. No email, direct line or mobile was published on any page that surfaced, so professional_email and professional_phone are left blank rather than guessed; the actionable routes are his own website, his Facebook practice page, and the two hospital profiles.
